meta.claim: defendant A: RENEWING and REBINDING are the protocol's own twin pair -- both are lease-extension waiting rooms that send DHCPREQUEST and leave on the identical 'DHCPACK/Record lease' label -- so they could be swapped and compressed into one state
meta.why_it_looks_legal: sec.4.4.5 describes them as the same activity differing only in unicast vs broadcast; both leave on the identical event label 'DHCPACK/Record lease, set timers T1, T2' toward BOUND
meta.why_it_is_not_a_symmetry: RENEWING has a third outgoing edge (T2 expires/Broadcast DHCPREQUEST -> REBINDING) that REBINDING lacks, and REBINDING cannot reach RENEWING; their event sets differ (DHCPNAK vs 'DHCPNAK, Lease expired' labels, T2 broadcast vs no T2)
meta.semantics_note: event-class model: semantics declared "fixed"; the relabel row in expected.json is the diagnostic contrast reading
